task.spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  a
 - output q (3 bits)

The module implements a sequential circuit. Read the simulation waveforms
to determine what the circuit does, then implement it.

  time  clk a   q
  0ns   0   1   x
  5ns   1   1   4
  10ns  0   1   4
  15ns  1   1   4
  20ns  0   1   4
  25ns  1   1   4
  30ns  0   1   4
  35ns  1   1   4
  40ns  0   1   4
  45ns  1   0   4
  50ns  0   0   4
  55ns  1   0   5
  60ns  0   0   5
  65ns  1   0   6
  70ns  0   0   6
  75ns  1   0   0
  80ns  0   0   0
  85ns  1   0   1
  90ns  0   0   1
task.constraints: SystemVerilog, single self-contained TopModule DUT; xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI.
